observable_requirements.contract: In the theme style variation preview, the two highlighted color swatches must prioritize the text color ('color.text') and button background color ('elements.button.color.background', falling back to link color 'elements.link.color.text'), excluding the card's background color ('color.background').
When the candidate palette contains color items with identical slugs, the preview component must render both swatches without key collisions or React duplicate key warnings.

preserved_behaviors: Variation title, inline CSS, container dimensions, and focus states continue to render correctly.
Colors matching the card background color are excluded from the highlighted swatches.
behavioral_contract.implementation_variation: Different internal filtering, sorting, or swatch indexing strategies are valid as long as the text and button background colors take precedence over incidental palette ordering and duplicate slugs render stably without key collision.

coverage.assertion_summary: Existing unit tests do not inspect the selection or color values of the highlighted swatches rendered in GlobalStylesVariationPreview.
coverage.reason: There are no existing tests asserting the color resolution and prioritization logic for variation preview swatches.

test_bundles.coverage_gap_reason: GlobalStylesVariationPreview was not covered by unit tests verifying the swatch prioritization of text/button colors over arbitrary palette colors, nor duplicate slug handling.
test_bundles.why_assertions_measure_requirements: The tests mock the Gutenberg global styles and settings hooks with specific palettes, text colors, and button colors, then inspect the rendered swatch background colors and DOM keys to verify prioritization and key uniqueness.
test_bundles.predicted_base_behavior: On base commit, highlightedColors selects the first two non-background palette items regardless of text/button styling, failing swatch color assertions, and uses duplicate slugs directly as React keys.
test_bundles.predicted_reference_behavior: With the fix, highlightedColors prioritizes text and button background colors and renders both swatches with index-qualified unique keys.
stable_test_ids: GlobalStylesVariationPreview should prioritize text and button background colors in highlighted swatches
GlobalStylesVariationPreview should fallback button background to link color when button background is not explicitly defined
GlobalStylesVariationPreview should render swatches without key collisions when duplicate slugs exist
environment_assumptions: Repository dependencies are installed and test environment executes with Jest and jsdom.
test_bundles.equivalence_self_check: Any implementation that prioritizes text and button background/link color over default palette order and provides distinct keys for rendered swatches will pass.
vacuous_pass_checks: Swatches array length is explicitly asserted to be 2 before inspecting background colors.
Specific RGB background colors are checked against expected resolved values.
test_bundles.surface_signal_resistance: Simply sorting paletteColors without checking text/button background tokens will fail the swatch color assertions.
